title: Building is from scratch!! Better for smaller shoes..!!
text:
Building is from scratch!! Better for smaller shoes..!!. Wow! A bit intimidating when seeing the construction that must take place.. every section of PVC pipe comes in single sections and must be built one connector at a time!! Truly, a bit of a jigsaw puzzle so I recommend first spreading out and grouping all pieces into their matching counterparts. Next unroll one mesh “platform” at a time and insert pipe inside the mesh sleeves and cap with corners to create the physical platform- repeat for all 4 levels. Once you have shelf structure to work with.. it’s a lot more feasible to connect the layered tower. I’m assuming this is the reason for the lower price point.. The buyer does 100% of the construction- something to keep in mind when purchasing! If a PVC pipe tower is not in your wheelhouse.. another option maybe better.

Once assembled.. this has a lower height profile which helps keep it stable. This is definitely smaller in size and could be useful in tight or limited spaces. However, if using with adult size shoes…this more likely is to fit 6-8pair only (depending on the shoe.. some shelves may only fit 3 single shoes vs. 4…) I would definitely recommend this for children size shoes or, adults with smaller feet!

Overall, this is not for easiest purchase for convenience! It will take a bit of patience to assemble.. and once built it does have limited capacity. So, be certain it will fit your specific needs in its sizing and structure prior to ordering. I deducted a star for the intense building…(It would be nice to include in description this will come 100% unassembled- as that may make a big difference for some.. I can’t imagine my parents at their age trying to put something like this together?!!) and deducted a star bc, 2 adult pair of running shoes can’t fit on shelf- not in size 10mens. And it state this can hold 8-10… otherwise, this has merit for specific needs if they match this shoe racks capacity! I hope this info can help your decision.
